args.message: Revenue by city size class: large 205,080.28 (3,110 orders), medium 100,075.84 (1,481 orders), small 26,339.03 (409 orders), and 1,193.30 (16 orders) for cities not in the reference table. I matched each customer to the city table on both city name and region, because the same city name can have a different size class in different regions (for example, Oslo is "large" in region 1 and "small" in region 2). The 1,193.30 group covers the customer whose city is Paris, which isn't in the reference table. It also includes any orders whose customer ID doesn't match a customer record, since those orders have no city either. All order statuses ("ok" and "bad") are included.
